label: Paul, Philippians 2.6: The letter presents Christ Jesus as existing in God’s form and not…
interpretation: Third-person epistolary assertion, not Jesus’s self-claim or an established event. The letter presents Christ Jesus as existing in God’s form and not regarding being equal with God as harpagmos; the disputed noun is retained without choosing acquisition, retention or exploitation. See docs/philippians-christology.md for semantic alternatives and historical gaps.
